facts.text: I have trouble sticking to my bedtime routine on weekends.
I want tips to help me stay consistent with my bedtime routine on weekends.
I want to use a guided meditation app to help me fall asleep faster and improve the quality of my sleep.
I want to use the guided meditation app during the middle of the night if I wake up and have trouble falling back asleep.
I have been using the guided meditation app in the middle of the night when I wake up.
I sometimes still have trouble falling back asleep even when I use the guided meditation app in the middle of the night.
I want suggestions for other things I can try to help me fall back asleep.
I want to try aromatherapy for sleep.
I have heard that lavender scents and vanilla scents are good for sleep.
I want to know how to use essential oils safely and effectively for sleep.
I want to talk about using lavender oil for sleep.
I will get a diffuser and some lavender oil to try it out.

keyphrases: middle of the night wake up

events.text: User plans to get a diffuser and some lavender oil to try lavender oil for sleep.
